description: Pattern-based hooks for sensitive git staging, generated file paths, and large Write content or added patch text. Supports Claude Code, Grok Build, and native Codex tool payloads. Requires jq; see README for limits.

hooks.command: command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "ogxo-guards/env-file-guard: jq not found; this hook is inactive. Install jq to enable it." >&2; exit 1; }; bash "${PLUGIN_ROOT:-${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}}/hooks/env-file-guard.sh"

command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "ogxo-guards/file-protection: jq not found; this hook is inactive. Install jq to enable it." >&2; exit 1; }; bash "${PLUGIN_ROOT:-${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}}/hooks/file-guard.sh" paths

command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "ogxo-guards/large-file-guard: jq not found; this hook is inactive. Install jq to enable it." >&2; exit 1; }; bash "${PLUGIN_ROOT:-${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}}/hooks/file-guard.sh" size

command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "ogxo-guards/file-protection: jq not found; this hook is inactive. Install jq to enable it." >&2; exit 1; }; bash "${PLUGIN_ROOT:-${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}}/hooks/file-guard.sh" paths

command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "ogxo-guards/large-file-guard: jq not found; this hook is inactive. Install jq to enable it." >&2; exit 1; }; bash "${PLUGIN_ROOT:-${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}}/hooks/file-guard.sh" size
